scripts.build:all: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && npm run build:admin
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix apps/backend install && npm --prefix apps/frontend install && npm --prefix admin install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend,admin" -c "cyan,blue,magenta" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.dev:full: concurrently "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.lint: npm --prefix apps/frontend run lint && npm --prefix admin run lint
